root.label: Idaho women housed in county jails on September 15, 2026

events.label: Idaho women housed in county jails on September 15, 2026

slots.name: women in county jails
slots.sentence: On Sept. 15, 186 women in state custody were housed in county-run jails that don’t offer the same programs as prisons, according to the Department of Correction.

slots.name: women with parole hearings
slots.sentence: Eighteen of those women have a parole hearing scheduled within the next six months.
